follow-up time: Until resumption of menstruation or pregnancy attempt (if desired)
cohort: Thirty-eight patients who underwent emergent TAE for intractable uterine bleeding between 2010 and 2019
finding: Emergent TAE was found to be effective and safe in treating intractable uterine bleeding with a high success rate (86.8%) and preservation of ovarian and endometrial function, as indicated by the resumption of menstruation in most patients.
